values.note: Back-in RV site $25 a night, pull-through $30 (tent $20). $3.50 reservation fee per unit.

fees.source: https://cityoflaurelmontana.com/1325/Campground-Reservations ('Camping Fees: (By Reservation Only) Tent - $20/Night, Back In - $25/Night, Pull Through - $30/Night. Each reservation will be charged a $3.50 reservation fee per unit.'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: 'No RV, camping, or human waste dumping of any kind is allowed.' Dumpsters in Riverside Park.
By reservation only, through the City's Firefly Reservations page. 16 days within a consecutive 30-day period. Check-in after 2 p.m., check-out by 11 a.m.

booking.source: https://cityoflaurelmontana.com/1325/Campground-Reservations ('Camping Fees: (By Reservation Only)', 'RV and Tent camping are limited to 16 days, within a consecutive 30-day period', link to app.fireflyreservations.com/Reserve/Property/LaurelRiversideRVPark), read 2026-10-22

note: City of Laurel Riverside Park on the Yellowstone River off US-212. Tent, RV (back-in and pull-through) and cabin sites; boat ramp and picnic areas. --Claude
summary: City-run (Laurel Public Works), reservation only via Firefly Reservations. Confirmed pull-throughs; added $25-$30 (2026) with $3.50 reservation fee, dry camping only (no hookups), no dump, 16-day limit, reservable/never FCFS. Showers left as derived (the current City page does not mention them). Note: dropped the old rates ($10/$15/$20) the City page contradicts and the restated shower line.
